correctness.rationale: For strictly positive rank-one B^ell=beta_ell u v^T with a_iell=u_i/delta_iell and independent columns, every interior equilibrium corresponds bijectively to positive force pair C with x_iell=s_i a_iell C_ell and s_i=1/(1+sum a_iell C_ell). Phi(C)=sum v_i log(1+a_i·C)-sum C_ell/beta_ell has strictly negative Hessian and coercivity, so a unique maximizer. The inward KKT derivatives at pure-virus axes equal (I_other|resident-1)/beta_other, proving exact mutual-invasion iff interior coexistence. The Jacobian symmetrizer W_iell=v_i/(s_i u_i C_ell) is positive; weighted Cauchy–Schwarz makes WJ negative definite with strictness by rank-two condition. Sign-conjugated I+hJ is entrywise nonnegative under stated physical Euler restriction, Perron spectral radius <1. Fresh exact-rational two-node check verified states [[4/25,1/25],[1/25,4/25]] and eigenvalues -19/10 ±3sqrt29/10 and -19/10 ±sqrt13/2, all negative. No global attraction or proportional-column claim.
